reviewSamples.author: Photo of Claire Price
reviewSamples.text: We hired Sam to complete three projects in our home: shiplap the entire office, shiplap an accent wall in our bedroom, and add wall texture to our kid's room. Sam was professional and did great work. I appreciated his attention to detail. We are very happy with the way all projects turned out.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of David Brooks
reviewSamples.text: Sam at Coastland Carpentry did a great job from my initial contact showing him some design ideas to bringing it to a beautiful finish in my home. Responsive, talented and care to detail are just a few of the words describing the overall experience. Can't say enough about his work. Highly recommended!
